subject: Superintendent Candidate Interviews
overview: The Medford School Committee conducted its second night of public interviews for the superintendent search, interviewing candidates Dr. Marice Edouard-Vincent and Thomas Martellone.

items.title: Call to Order and Opening Remarks
items.summary: Mayor Burke opened the meeting, outlined the schedule for deciding on candidate site visits, and led a moment of silence in memory of Dr. Martin Luther King Jr.

items.title: Interview with Dr. Marice Edouard-Vincent
items.summary: The committee interviewed Boston Public Schools Instructional Superintendent Dr. Marice Edouard-Vincent on topics including management style, student achievement data, English learner instruction, and career technical education.

items.title: Interview with Thomas Martellone
items.summary: The committee interviewed Lexington elementary principal Thomas Martellone regarding district leadership, special education accountability, budget administration, school safety, and student engagement.
